results.title: They took my husband
results.overview: When her husband is detained by ICE, Chelsea, MA resident Brenda Romero must take over his construction business, manage her family’s increasingly precarious finances and navigate looming homelessness. Along the way, she becomes a vocal immigrant rights advocate fighting for her family - and for a community in the crosshairs of a federal immigration crackdown.

results.title: Tammy Pescatelli: Mrs. Saturday Night
results.overview: Watch Tammy Pescatelli deliver her hilarious stand-up comedy special, Mrs. Saturday Night, filmed live at the Triad Theater. 😂  Tammy takes the stage in New York City to share her brutally honest take on everyday life. Known for her fearless storytelling and sharp observational comedy, she turns relatable situations into a non-stop series of laughs.  This full comedy special captures Tammy Pescatelli at her best, with an energetic delivery that keeps the audience engaged from start to finish. If you enjoy bold, unfiltered humor from one of the sharpest voices in the industry, this set is for you. 🎤

results.overview: In the 90s, and following the dissolution of the Soviet Union and the resulting conflicts, four Russian girls travel to Egypt and start to mingle in the Egyptian society, developing a shared admiration towards it in a way that makes them unwilling to return to their homeland.

results.title: NWE: From Italy to the World
results.original_title: NWE: From Italy to the World
results.overview: A journey behind the scenes of European wrestling. Amid spectacle and sacrifice, we follow the vision of NWE founder Roberto Indiano, the return of Ultimate Warrior, and the stories of extraordinary athletes. An intimate, ironic, and compelling account that—through moments of humor, adrenaline, and behind-the-scenes insights—reveals the men behind the masks and the rebirth of a passion for the sport that has never faded.
